event.name: Hops Drops The Evergreen Music & Beer Festival

profile.description: Adventure Zone has emailed Hops Drops multiple times historically. Current 2026 information references the festival on Oct. 17, 2026. The event may have compatible adult and family audiences, but its short operating window and music/craft-beverage fundraiser format do not justify the setup, staffing and travel economics of a full Adventure Zone package under the current format.

notes.subject: 2026 review — not worth pursuing at current event length
notes.body: Gmail shows Adventure Zone outreach to Hops Drops in 2022, 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. Adult/beer events are eligible, but Hops Drops is too short a festival window to justify hauling, setup, teardown and staffing for a full package at the current format. Do not pursue routine 2026 outreach unless the event expands to a materially longer operating window or the organizer proposes economics strong enough to justify the setup.
